name: intro
label: Record Ekegusii speech. Each recording builds the dataset that will teach an AI to hear and speak Ekegusii.

name: speaker_id
label: Speaker code
hint: A code to track this speaker across recordings without using their name. Example: TW-F-45 (Township, female, age 45)

name: read_note
label: Read the sentence below clearly and naturally in Ekegusii. Pause, then tap record.

name: sentence_text
label: Type the sentence you will read
hint: Copy from the printed sentence card, or type a sentence from the set above

name: read_audio
label: Record yourself reading the sentence above

name: read_quality
label: Recording quality?
hint: Was it clear, or was there background noise?

name: free_note
label: Say a word, phrase, story or anything in Ekegusii. Type what you will say first, then record.

name: free_text_guz
label: What will you say? (Ekegusii)
hint: Write it in Ekegusii first, then record yourself saying it

name: speech_type
label: What kind of speech is this?

name: word_note
label: Record individual words clearly. Say each word twice with a pause between.

name: word_phonetic
label: How it sounds (phonetic)
hint: Write how it sounds for someone who doesn't speak Ekegusii

name: word_audio
label: Record the word (say it twice clearly)

name: consent_note
label: This recording will be used to teach a computer to understand and speak Ekegusii. It will be published as part of an open speech dataset.

name: consent_speech
label: Does the speaker agree to include this recording in the Ekegusii speech dataset?

name: consent_name
label: Does the speaker agree to be credited by name?

name: consent_record
label: Where is the consent recorded?
hint: Signed form reference, or 'verbal consent on recording'

name: privacy_ok
label: I confirm the speaker agreed to this recording.
